answer: Underwriter-capacity admission: a newcomer enters only with a cedar bond posted by an established agent, each underwriter covering at most four entrants and forfeiting that bond jointly if two of them are later proven kin. A farm of k clones must therefore recruit k/4 distinct underwriters, each pricing correlated default, so cost grows super-linearly in k. Every entrant also files a sonnet-length original statement whose raw hash is logged in the public timber registry, so recycled text cannot re-anchor a fresh identity.
